{{Top|leg}}
The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] maintained '''training facilities''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vessitoar]] around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. A shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] was stolen while in transit to the facilities, by agents of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Rethorn]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Qan Gindoch]] then transported a number of the stolen weapons to an [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]], where they were impounded during a security check at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]].
